text: The attenuated muscle protein synthesis duration following regimented training may be related at least in part to the protective response of the repeated bout effect. Given that well-trained individuals have conditioned their muscles to the stress of resistance exercise, the associated tissue breakdown is reduced and thus there is less need for remodeling (18).
book: Science and Development of Muscle Hypertrophy
chapter: Chapter 7: Factors in Maximal Hypertrophic Development
